mapper.select: SELECT id, playlist_id, music_id, order_no, created_at FROM playlist_items WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, playlist_id, music_id, order_no, created_at FROM playlist_items WHERE playlist_id = #{playlistId} ORDER BY order_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT m.spotify_uri FROM playlist_items pi INNER JOIN music m ON m.id = pi.music_id WHERE pi.playlist_id = #{playlistId} AND m.spotify_uri IS NOT NULL AND m.spotify_uri != '' ORDER BY pi.order_no ASC, pi.id ASC

SELECT pi.music_id AS musicId, m.spotify_track_id AS spotifyTrackId, m.spotify_uri AS spotifyUri FROM playlist_items pi INNER JOIN music m ON m.id = pi.music_id WHERE pi.playlist_id = #{playlistId} ORDER BY pi.order_no ASC, pi.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_items pi INNER JOIN music m ON m.id = pi.music_id WHERE pi.playlist_id = #{playlistId} AND m.spotify_uri IS NOT NULL AND m.spotify_uri != ''
